questions.question: How is Job described at the beginning of the book?
options: Foolish and reckless, scorning the ways of God and of men
Poor and obscure, entirely unknown among all of his people
Blameless and upright, fearing God and turning away from evil
Wicked and proud, harshly oppressing the poor folk all around him
questions.answer: Blameless and upright, fearing God and turning away from evil

questions.question: What did Satan claim was the reason for Job's faithfulness?
options: His own great wisdom had shaped him
His many friends had taught him to
He was afraid of God's punishment
God had blessed and protected him
questions.answer: God had blessed and protected him

questions.question: In one day Job lost his oxen, sheep, camels, servants, and all his children.
Job said, 'The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away; blessed be the _____ of the LORD.'
In all this Job did not sin or charge God with _____.
